categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor IC packaging and testing services, focusing on memory ICs, LCD driver ICs, and logic/mixed-signal ICs. It manages four main business units: packaging production, memory and mixed-signal testing, LCD driver IC production, and wafer bumping production. These segments provide integrated backend semiconductor manufacturing services including multi-chip packaging, thin small-outline packages, ball grid arrays, chip-on-film, chip-on-glass, and wafer-level chip scale packaging.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor packaging technologies such as 2P2M thick copper redistribution layers combined with high copper pillar applications, 12-inch single-wafer thinning for wafer-level chip scale packaging (WLCSP), ultra-narrow width COF packaging for display driver ICs, fifth-generation DDR memory packaging, and thermal enhanced flip-chip BGA with heat sink. It also develops silver alloy bumping processes, 1M1P RDL structures for memory products, dual-layer COF for Micro-LED TVs, non-rectangular gold bumping for COF, hybrid bonding of flip-chip and wire bonding, and high-heat dissipation chip-scale packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major semiconductor design companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), and wafer foundries. Its products are applied in automotive electronics, information technology, communications, mobile devices, wearable technology, and consumer electronics. Key end markets include memory ICs, LCD driver ICs, logic/mixed-signal ICs, and wafer bumping for various high-growth applications such as AI high-bandwidth memory, smart handheld devices, and automotive electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily concentrated in Taiwan, with significant activities in Asia and the Americas. The company has subsidiaries in Shanghai, China, and the United States, supporting its global customer base. Sales distribution shows approximately 80% domestic sales in Taiwan and about 20% export sales mainly to Asia and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in IC backend services including packaging, testing, and wafer bumping. It acts as an outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) provider, supporting upstream IC design and wafer fabrication companies by delivering advanced packaging and testing solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding capacity and technology in high-growth end markets such as automotive electronics and advanced mobile devices. R&D focuses on developing advanced packaging technologies like fine-pitch bonding, flip-chip, WLCSP, RDL, stacked-die, multi-chip, and system-in-package (SiP). The company emphasizes innovation in materials, mechanical and electrical properties, and collaborates closely with customers for co-development. It plans to invest about 5% of annual revenue in R&D to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through contract manufacturing services including IC packaging, testing, and wafer bumping. The company provides turnkey backend semiconductor manufacturing services to customers, earning income from processing fees based on volume and complexity of packaging and testing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the top ten global semiconductor packaging and testing providers and the second largest LCD driver IC backend service provider in Taiwan. It competes with firms like SPIL and ASE in Taiwan and faces competition from Chinese OSATs expanding capacity with government subsidies. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology, scale economies, and long-term partnerships with major IDM customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$22.7 billion, representing a 6.3% growth over the prior year. Net profit attributable to the parent company was about NT$1.42 billion with a return on equity of 5.7%. Total assets stood at NT$45.4 billion with a healthy debt ratio of 44.7%. The company maintains a stable financial structure with ongoing capital expenditures around NT$5.45 billion to support capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced packaging technologies, comprehensive backend semiconductor services, and strong R&D capabilities. It offers integrated one-stop solutions covering memory, display driver, and logic IC packaging and testing, enabling customers to reduce costs and improve time-to-market. Its commitment to quality, innovation, and long-term customer partnerships, along with a robust intellectual property portfolio, strengthens its competitive position in high-growth niche markets such as automotive and advanced mobile applications.
